description: This file defines an Angular component 'CoordinatesTableComponent' that displays a table of coordinate values (left, top, right, bottom) or null if coordinates are not provided.

classes.name: CoordinatesTableComponent
classes.description: Angular component rendering a coordinates table, with input 'coordinates' object and a method to check for presence of coordinate values.

methods.name: hasCoordinates
methods.description: Checks if any coordinate value (left, top, right, bottom) exists in the input 'coordinates' object.
